title: Article 20 — Protection in respect of conviction for offences

content.heading: Protection in respect of conviction for offences
content.text: No person shall be convicted of any offence except for violation of a law in force at the time of the act, nor subjected to a greater penalty than that then authorised. No person shall be prosecuted and punished for the same offence more than once. No person accused of any offence shall be compelled to be a witness against himself.
